title: 第09章 执法堂来人第10章 三转蛊师
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
“孙师弟，你要的蛊虫装好了。”
王邻赔笑着将装好蛊虫的小罐子递给孙蒙。
“嗯。”
孙蒙点了点头，“回头好好教育一下那小子吧，希望不要有下次了。”
王邻笑道：“刚才他已认识到自已的错误，说绝对不会有下次了。”
“那就好，我先走了。”
目的达成，孙蒙不再久留，带着装上蛊虫的罐子离去。
走在路上。
不知为何，他感觉罐子晃动的厉害。
“什么鬼？”
孙蒙皱眉，“那个新来的，不会想报复我，故意给我装的残蛊吧？想死不成？”
他越想越觉得如此，一把将盖子掀开。
噗——！
刹那间，一股毒雾喷出。
“臭毒虫！”
孙蒙猛地捂住鼻子，刚要将本命蛊放出，就感觉手臂一麻，顿时双目晕眩，昏天暗地。
“还有杀人蜂！”
更恐怖的是，这些蛊虫带着极其强烈有目的性的杀意，根本不像是散养的。
绝对有人在背后操控！
他吸干一只气血蛊，强打住精神，扫视四周，却感知不到任何气息。

“难道是以念控蛊的手段？”
整个十二洞，能做到以念控蛊的人，只有寥寥几个。
谁会闲着来杀他这个小人物？
孙蒙绝望了。
杀人蜂的麻痹毒性不断侵蚀，连心口处都传来钻心的疼痛。
“还有钻心蛊？”
他瞪大了双眼，知晓这是一个死局，求生的信念都断了，扑通一声栽倒在地。
弥留之际，他想到了那个残蛊楼的新人。
“是他吗？”
“不可能吧，可他好像说…不会再有下次了，原来是这个意思吗？”
……
几天后。
王邻正和李元吃饭，一群身着戴着银色面具的人突然来到残蛊楼。
王邻双目一瞪，身体都在打颤。
“执法团的人？”
“怎么会来这里？”
不待他开口，戴着银色面具的执法团弟子一步踏上前，冷冽的气息散发开来。
“残蛊楼管事王邻何在？”
“我是。”
老王应道。

“王邻，你涉嫌杀害同门，跟我们走一趟。”
执法团弟子上前，扣住王邻。
“李元不要怕，没事的。”
王邻不知道发生了什么事，强装镇静，叮嘱道：
“什么都别管，好好守护残蛊楼，等我回来。”
content_en:
"Junior Brother Sun, the Gu insect you want is installed."
Wang Lin smiled apologetically and handed the small jar filled with poisonous insects to Sun Meng.
"Yeah."
Sun Meng nodded, "Let's go back and educate that boy properly. I hope there won't be a next time."
Wang Lin smiled and said, "He realized his mistake just now and said there would never be a next time."
"That's good, I'll leave first."
With the goal accomplished, Sun Meng did not stay long and left with the jar filled with poisonous insects.
Walk on the road.
For some reason, he felt the jar shaking violently.
"What the hell?"
Sun Meng frowned, "The new guy doesn't want to take revenge on me and deliberately faked the poison for me, right? Does he want to die?"
The more he thought about it, the more he felt so, and he opened the lid.
puff--!
In an instant, a poisonous mist spurted out.
"Stinky poisonous insect!"
Sun Meng suddenly covered his nose, and just as he was about to release his life Gu, he felt his arms go numb, and his eyes suddenly became dizzy and dark.
"And killer bees!"
What's even more terrifying is that these Gu insects have extremely strong and purposeful killing intent, and they don't look like they are free-range at all.
There is definitely someone behind it!
He sucked up a Qi and Blood Gu, forced himself to keep his spirits up, and looked around, but couldn't feel any breath.
"Is it a way to control the poison with thoughts?"
In the entire Twelve Cave, there are only a few people who can control Gu with thoughts.
Who would take the time to kill a little guy like him?
Sun Meng was desperate.
The paralytic poison of the killer bees continued to erode, and even the heart was filled with heartbreaking pain.
"And Cruciatus Gu?"
His eyes widened, knowing that this was a dead end. His belief in survival was gone, and he fell to the ground with a plop.
When he was dying, he thought of the newcomer in Can Gu Tower.
"Is it him?"
"It's impossible, but he seemed to say... there won't be a next time. Is that what he meant?"
…
A few days later.
Wang Lin was having dinner with Li Yuan when a group of people wearing silver masks suddenly came to Can Gu Tower.
Wang Lin's eyes widened and his body was trembling.
"Members of the law enforcement team?"
"Why are you here?"
Before he could speak, a disciple of the law enforcement regiment wearing a silver mask stepped forward, a cold aura spreading out.
"Where is Wang Lin, the steward of Can Gu Tower?"
"I am."
Lao Wang responded.
"Wang Neighbor, you are suspected of killing a fellow disciple, please come with us."
The disciples from the law enforcement team stepped forward and detained Wang Lin.
"Don't be afraid Li Yuan, it's okay."
Wang Lin didn't know what happened, so he pretended to be calm and warned:
"Don't worry about anything, just protect the Can Gu Tower and wait for me to come back."
